idea: Letters & first words #4 – Letter D (JIMMY'S ROOM, Jimmy in HOME onesie on the round blue rug beside his blue toy box with yellow stars): hook 'Wow! Look! A big letter D!' – a big chunky orange foam letter D pops up out of the toy box right beside Baby Jimmy's face and he gasps; chorus 'D, D, D! Duh, duh, duh!'; 'D is for dinosaur! Stomp, stomp, stomp!' (his soft green dinosaur plush) + copy-me 'Stomp your feet! Stomp with me!'; 'D is for dog! Woof, woof, woof!' (a soft brown toy puppy) + copy-me 'Wiggle, wiggle! Wiggle with me!'; D, dinosaur and dog in a neat row on the toy box – Jimmy points at the D and asks the viewer 'Dinosaur, dog... what letter? Hmm?' (2 s humming pause) – 'D! D! D! Yay!'; lesson 'D says duh, duh, duh!'. Loop: the hook framing again, D, dinosaur and dog in a row on the toy box, bye-bye wave.
lesson: The letter D: its name, its sound 'duh' and two D words – dinosaur and dog.
calendar: Thursday 26 Nov 2026 (Thanksgiving), New York 04:42 = slot 1 = Letters & first words. Series: A (5 Nov), B (12 Nov), C (19 Nov) -> D.
place: JIMMY'S ROOM (reference jimmy-room.jpg): on the round blue rug with the big yellow star beside the blue toy box with yellow stars; shelf, bed and armchair out of frame

variety.outfit: HOME (light blue onesie with yellow star)

characters: BABY JIMMY: a cute chubby 1-year-old baby boy with fluffy curly ginger hair, big blue eyes, light freckles, rosy cheeks. wearing a light blue short-sleeve onesie with a small yellow star, barefoot.
supporting_objects: BIG LETTER D (chunky bright orange soft foam capital D), GREEN DINOSAUR (Jimmy's soft green dinosaur plush from his room), BROWN TOY DOG (soft fluffy brown toy puppy plush with floppy ears and a blue collar) – one each.

shots.frame: f1 – D pops out of the open toy box beside his face, big wow gasp; no dinosaur, no dog
f2 – D on the closed toy box, Jimmy holds the green dinosaur and makes it stomp; no dog
f3 – D on the toy box, Jimmy wiggles the brown toy dog; no dinosaur
f4 – D, dinosaur, dog in a neat row on the toy box; Jimmy points at the D
f5 – edit of f1: same framing, D, dinosaur and dog in a row on the toy box, bye-bye wave

learning.goal: Recognise the letter D, say its sound 'duh' and two D words: dinosaur and dog.
learning.shown_how: One big orange 3D foam letter D (correct orientation, checked at full size) beside Jimmy's face in every shot; the dinosaur, then the dog, then all three in one row; no other letters anywhere.
learning.interactive_moment: 0:18-0:19 'Dinosaur, dog... what letter? Hmm?' + 0:19-0:22 wordless humming pause (confirmed by transcription) -> 0:22 'D! D! D! Yay!' + cheer + confetti
learning.copy_me: 'Stomp your feet! Stomp with me!' (0:09) and 'Wiggle, wiggle! Wiggle with me!' (0:15)
learning.fact_check: Dinosaur and dog both start with the letter D (sound /d/ 'duh'); the letter D is upright and not mirrored in all frames; f1 only D, f2 D + dinosaur, f3 D + dog, f4/f5 D + dinosaur + dog (3 items).
learning.modeling: Positive: Jimmy plays gently with his toys and tidies them into a neat row; nothing wrong to correct.
learning.toddler_fit: Simple words, one baby, big face, his own cozy room, soft plush toys, the dino 'rawr' is a cute squeak, nothing scary.
